article.title: 更進新聞：Microsoft在Foundry公開預覽MAI Image 2.7與Flash
article.summary: Microsoft公布兩款可生成及編輯圖片的模型，開放Foundry公開預覽，並在MAI Labs推出Canvas。
highlights: MAI Image 2.7及Flash均支援透明背景。
Canvas由Flash支援，可從草圖開始，選取局部調整。
article.why: 商品與品牌設計團隊可比較兩款模型在背景去除及局部修改時，能否保留包裝顏色和標誌細節。
article.next_step: 以同一組商品素材測試兩款模型，比對透明邊緣、標誌和連續修改後的色差。
article.detail: Microsoft表示，MAI Image 2.7可修改物件的位置、顏色或材質。Canvas提供同一工作空間，讓使用者從文字提示或草圖產生圖片，再選取局部處理。對照兩款模型時，可用相同參考圖檢查材質和形狀是否保留，再計算通過品牌審核的素材所需修改次數。
article.title_en: Update: Microsoft previews MAI Image 2.7 and Flash publicly in Foundry
article.summary_en: Microsoft announced two models for generating and editing images in Foundry public preview and launched Canvas in MAI Labs.
highlights_en: MAI Image 2.7 and Flash both support transparent backgrounds.
Canvas runs on Flash and can turn a sketch into an image that users can edit in selected areas.
article.why_en: Brand and product designers can compare how well both models preserve packaging colors and logo details during cutouts and local edits.
article.next_step_en: Test both models with the same product assets and compare transparent edges, logos and color drift after successive edits.
article.detail_en: Microsoft says MAI Image 2.7 can change an object's position, color or material. Canvas lets users turn a prompt or sketch into an image and select areas to revise in the same workspace. Compare both models using the same reference image, check whether materials and shapes hold up, and count the revisions needed to pass brand review.
article.followup: 10月29日本刊報道初期以圖像編輯為主的預覽。本次新增生成、Flash版本及Canvas工作空間。
article.followup_en: Our October 29 issue covered the earlier editing preview. This announcement adds generation, Flash and the Canvas workspace.
